අƯ ɪෙශෂ
No. 1942/25 – FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 27, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. 2/2/1/101/(11)

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Allotments of lands mentioned below in extents of 0.0243 Hectare described in preliminary plan P. P. Gam. 3954 which surveyed and arrange by Superintendent of Survey Gampaha on behalf of Surveyor-General situated in 230 C Galthotamulla village in Mada Ptthuwa, in Gampaha Division secretarial Division, in Gampaha District, in Western Province.

1. Lot No. 1 Name of land: Hadawakagahalanda; Description of the land: Home land, contained 03 Coconut trees age about 40 years; Claimed by : Government First Claimed by Mr. Arachchi Appuhamilage Don Karunapala, Galthotumull, Yakkala; Extent: 0.0069 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Hadawakagahalanda; Description of the land: Home land, contained 03 Coconut trees age about 30 years, 01 coconut tree age about 03 years, 14 acrecanut

trees age about 20 years,01 “ Kaluwara wood” tree age about 30 years and 02 Agar wood trees age about 10 years.; Claimed by: Government; First Claimed by: Mr. Madurapperuma Arachchilage Jayarathna, No. 90, Galthotumull, Yakkala; Extent: 0.0135 Hectare.

3. Lot No. 3 Name of the land: Galakumbura; Description of the land: Paddy field; Claimed by: Government; First Claimed by: Not found; Extent: 0.0039 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired* are hereby required to appear personally, or agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Gampaha on the 20th day of January 2016, at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 13th Day of January, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
C. P. W. GUNATHILAKA, Divisional Secretary, Gampaha.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Gampaha, 23rd October, 2015. 12 - 439

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. DO/L/1/AQ/104.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

An Allotment of land in total extent of 0.767 Hectare depicted as lot No. 01 in Preliminary Plan No. K/4529 and dated 19.10.2015 Prepared by the Surveyor General situated in 800C West/Dodangoda/South in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dodangoda District of Kalutara in Western Province more fully described as follows.
1. Lot No. 1 Name of land: Silwerdail Watta; Land use: Garden; Original Claimant: Pradeshiya Sabhawa; Extent: 0.0767 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s Office, Dodangoda on the 16th day of December 2015, at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 09th Day of December, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
H. W. T. R. WETHTHASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Dodangoda.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Dodangoda, 19th November, 2015.
